entries.subject: Selected model
entries.finding: [Selected model](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/5913) and [original counted mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/63475/shape.txt) — included unchanged. ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by VLT/SPHERE images; fine relief is unresolved.

entries.subject: DAMIT documentation
entries.finding: [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) — coordinate units, pole, period and diameter semantics. CC BY 4.0.

entries.subject: Vernazza et al. (2021), VLT/SPHERE imaging survey of the largest main-belt asteroids: Final results and synthesis
entries.finding: [Vernazza et al. (2021), VLT/SPHERE imaging survey of the largest main-belt asteroids: Final results and synthesis](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...654A..56V) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the documented physical calibration supplies the selected scale. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 160.61 ± 3.05 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented.

entries.subject: Vernazza et al. (2021), ESO-hosted author manuscript
entries.finding: [Vernazza et al. (2021), ESO-hosted author manuscript](https://www.eso.org/public/archives/releases/sciencepapers/eso2114/eso2114a.pdf) — retained primary publication; see the body-specific selection and calibration above.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: No registered reflectance mosaic is supplied by this release; a neutral grid must mark unavailable imagery. Fine-scale craters, regolith and albedo are unresolved.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: The survey found no alternative archive solution for this target.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Versioned browser evidence
entries.finding: The README records two browser cases before final integration, with an asset comparison to the integrated files, but no tested code revision for those cases. This is an evidence limitation, not proof of a current rendering defect.
entries.revisitWhen: A focused browser check identifies the tested revision, relevant served asset pins and capture settings, or the original report can be reliably bound to that revision and its dependencies.
